_comment: Every value here corresponds to Table 4 of the paper. Edit paths.dataset_root before running anything.

paths._note: Must contain 'Training Set', 'Validation Set' and 'Testing Set' subfolders of BCIC2020-IV Track 3.

protocol.validation_role: selects architecture, seed, stopping epoch, feature block, classifier, C, fusion weight
protocol.test_role: scored exactly once, after every parameter is fixed
protocol.refit_before_test: selected configuration refit on train+validation (350 trials) using the validation-chosen architecture, seed and epoch

stage1_signal_conditioning.channel_normalisation: z-score per channel, training statistics only

stage1_quality_control.train_policy: hybrid: drop severe, winsorise the remainder

stage2_mdrg.window_convention: closed on both endpoints; 257 samples each; the midpoint sample j=256 is shared
stage2_mdrg.tangent_reference: log-Euclidean mean over training trials, per band and window
stage2_mdrg.tangent_vectorisation: upper triangle, off-diagonal scaled by sqrt(2), 171 coefficients
stage2_mdrg.feature_repair: training-column median imputation, then clipping to training 0.1 and 99.9 percentiles; degenerate columns widened by 1e-8. No column is ever removed; D stays 1656.

mdrg_branch_mlp.feature_standardisation: z-score per column, training statistics only

fusion.rule: single global mixture of calibrated class posteriors
fusion.selection_metric: macro-F1 on the official validation split
fusion.note: One scalar shared across all five classes. This replaces the earlier five per-class weights plus two branch temperatures, which was too large a search for 50 validation trials.

mdrg_model_selection.selection_metric: macro-F1 on the official validation split

graph_comparator.note: Adaptation of the multi-view consensus-graph principle, not a bit-for-bit reproduction: the public implementation selects parameters using evaluation-set labels, which is incompatible with this protocol. Here the validation split alone selects the parameters.

statistics.test: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank across the 15 participants
statistics.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm, within the family of macro-F1 comparisons against the proposed fusion
